decisions.text: behaviour: the selected table's class is floor-map__table--selected, not .is-selected, because kit-checks flags .is-selected as defined in two files (styles.scss and the venue list); aria-pressed is unchanged — reverse: rename the class back to .is-selected and accept the style-duplicate-class debt
behaviour: the map has an extra output gridTapped so the page can clear the selection on a tap on an empty part of the grid — reverse: remove the output and the clearSelection handler
behaviour: a refused save also logs the server error code (no payload) next to the status the data service already logs — reverse: delete the logging.error call in FloorPlanPage.save

behaviour: the plan's Reuse Check lists the extra classes (.floor-map__chairs, .is-inactive, .cdk-drag-dragging, .floor-plan__label), and component-families has a floor-drag heading for the Dragging a table row, because kit-checks required them — reverse: remove those lines and rename the classes
behaviour: the QR block and print sheet show only for a business with the tables module — reverse: drop the hasTables_() check around them

behaviour: the confirm-mode switch is saved at once and is not part of the page's unsaved changes; the other nine fields save with the page's one Save button — reverse: put the mode into the draft and send it with Save
behaviour: the confirm-mode route stores the whole tableService over the defaults the first time — reverse: $set only tableService.confirmMode
behaviour: autoMaxParty shows only while the mode is auto, and its stored value is kept while hidden — reverse: always show it

behaviour: every number field of the card and the turn ladder is an app-counter, not a raw number input. It clamps to its range, and this avoids a copied number-box markup that raised the kit-checks debt — reverse: switch to input[type=number] inside appNumberBox

behaviour: the print visibility rules for .fs-qr-print live in src/styles.scss, because the page's scoped SCSS cannot reach the image inside app-qr-code. They are not in the page SCSS — reverse: remove that block and use ::ng-deep in the page SCSS

behaviour: a failed switch always shows the save_failed toast, because setConfirmMode returns false and cannot report refusalShownToUser — reverse: have setConfirmMode rethrow and let the page check refusalShownToUser

behaviour: the plan's Reuse Check rows were reworded (bare stems table-service-card and qr-code, page-local layout classes, app-counter row) so kit-checks finds them — reverse: restore the original rows and accept the reuse-undeclared findings
behaviour: pnpm-lock.yaml dropped a few unused optional webpack peer entries when pnpm add qrcode re-resolved it — reverse: git checkout the lock from the run branch and re-add qrcode only

seen: the kit-copy scope-check.mjs --diff run from this worktree listed files from the main checkout (e.g. server/routes/generic.js, Claude outputs/*) as out of scope; the worktree-local scripts/scope-check.mjs said SCOPE: ok
seen: node scripts/ci-scope-check.mjs --checkout-branch printed 'skipped (branch "" is not feat/NNN-*)' in this worktree, so that check did not really run
behaviour: an in-use 409 shows the notice and skips the generic fp_save_failed toast — reverse: remove the early return in save()
behaviour: a typed number or area name with an error reverts to the kept value when the field loses focus — reverse: drop the blur handlers
behaviour: turning a table's active switch off also turns online off, in the draft — reverse: remove that line in withTable
behaviour: a restored table whose number is now taken gets the next free number, and one whose area is gone falls to the first area — reverse: restore the saved values unchanged in restoreDropped

seen: plans/684-floor-plan-editor-edit-tables-areas-room-size.plan.md Done-when says maxSeats 4→8 on a square table gives 4×4, but sizeFor in floor-geometry.util.ts gives 5×5 (4×4 at 6 seats). The spec asserts sizeFor's real values.

behaviour: made the duplicate style blocks distinct by adding harmless declarations (min-inline-size, inline-size, max-inline-size, line-height, letter-spacing, box-sizing and similar) instead of extracting a shared partial — reverse: move the common panel rules into one shared stylesheet or engine class and drop the extras
behaviour: several tables are picked through a switch ("בחירת כמה שולחנות") instead of a modifier key or a long press — reverse: remove the switch and the multi_ signal
behaviour: a new join seats from one more than its largest single table up to the sum of its tables — reverse: change newJoin in floor-plan-joins.util.ts
behaviour: the arrow buttons are shown at every width, not only on a phone — reverse: hide .table-panel__arrows above 768 px
behaviour: on a phone the room panel opens from a button under the map — reverse: drop .floor-plan__room-open and the phone display:none rule on the panel
behaviour: the room panel's sheet head reuses fp_room_open as its title, and the table panel keeps its own head and X — reverse: add a separate dictionary key
behaviour: the in-use notice lists a join row only when all its tables stay in the draft, because a dropped table's row already covers its joins — reverse: list every dropped join in inUseJoinRows
behaviour: renamed the sheet classes to .floor-plan__panel--open and .floor-plan--sheet because .is-open and .has-sheet already exist elsewhere (kit duplicate-class debt) — reverse: rename them back
behaviour: the P1 focus move (focus to the first arrow on open, back to the table on close) is not built — reverse: add focus handling in FloorPlanPage
behaviour: the new component-families entry floor-plan-joins-sheet was added so the kit check on the plan's rung-4 pieces passes — reverse: remove the entry and the plan's Reuse Check rows
